from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests,json,hashlib,re
root=Path.cwd();d=root/'reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_causes_single_release_v1'
assert not d.exists(),'固定例表已有结果，不能重跑'
d.mkdir();(d/'sources').mkdir()
protocol={'study_id':'510300_FED_RESERVE_CAUSES_SINGLE_RELEASE_V1','experiment_id':'E8',
 'registered_at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),'phase':'SINGLE_RELEASE_CAUSE_IDENTITY_NOT_SCORE',
 'hypothesis':'持券或储备供给变化不能单独决定银行准备金方向；财政账户和逆回购等负债端变化可能抵消，需先按同频同口径核对原因构成。',
 'selection_disclosure':'E7有限来源路线已结束。此前已通过官方网页看到2023-09-14单表数值，因此这个例表不是未观察筛选，也不是独立验证；未读取或选择本例后的股票收益。',
 'fixed_source':'https://www.federalreserve.gov/releases/h41/20230914/',
 'scope':'同一公布日表1及continued，周均水平与对2023-09-06的周均变化；不混入周三时点列、同比变化或当前修订时序。',
 'fixed_fields':['Total factors supplying reserve funds','Total factors, other than reserve balances, absorbing reserve funds',
 'Reserve balances with Federal Reserve Banks','Securities held outright','Reverse repurchase agreements',
 'U.S. Treasury, General Account','Currency in circulation','Treasury cash holdings',
 'Deposits with F.R. Banks, other than reserve balances','Other liabilities and capital'],
 'required_identity':'准备金周变化=供给因素总变化−其他吸收因素总变化；以百万美元为原单位，舍入差不超过2百万美元。',
 'required_cause_bridge':'准备金变化=供给总变化−逆回购总变化−TGA变化−货币流通变化−财政现金变化−非TGA其他存款变化−其他负债资本变化。',
 'limitations':['会计恒等式不等于外生因果识别。','逆回购总项包含外国官方及其他账户，不能称为纯ON RRP。',
 '准备金增加不等于中国指数资金流入或价格必涨。','同表周均与周三时点不能混用。',
 '原公开日期可定位但首次版本/实际收到时刻未认证。'],
 'source_budget':{'single_release_pages':1,'attempts':2,'no_403_429_retry':True},
 'equity_returns_loaded':False,'new_fits':0,'new_accounts':0,'new_repository_code_edits':0,
 'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'orders_authorized':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','goal_achieved':False}
p=d/'protocol.json';p.write_text(json.dumps(protocol,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
freeze={'protocol_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'known_source_example_disclosed':True,
 'registered_before_actual_extraction_and_equity_returns':True,
 'e7_result_sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/'reports/research/510300_cftc_treasury_position_source_qualification_v1/result.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(d/'freeze.json').write_text(json.dumps(freeze,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
attempts=[];raw=None
for attempt in range(1,3):
 try:
  resp=requests.get(protocol['fixed_source'],timeout=40);attempts.append({'attempt':attempt,'status':resp.status_code})
  if resp.status_code in [403,429]:break
  resp.raise_for_status();raw=resp.content;break
 except requests.RequestException as e:
  if not attempts or attempts[-1]['attempt']!=attempt:attempts.append({'attempt':attempt})
  attempts[-1]['error']=str(e)
assert raw is not None,'原例表不可得，停止提取'
source=d/'sources/20230914_H41原公布表.html';source.write_bytes(raw)
soup=BeautifulSoup(raw,'html.parser')
print('表格数量',len(soup.find_all('table')))
for i,tab in enumerate(soup.find_all('table')):
 print('表',i,tab.get_text(' | ',strip=True)[:1800])
(d/'source_receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps({'source_url':protocol['fixed_source'],'retrieved_at':datetime.now().astimezone().isoformat(),
 'file':'sources/'+source.name,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(raw),'attempts':attempts},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
